nom: Urban Skin Rx Even Tone Cleansing Bar 3-in-1 Treatment

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report the bar feels effective without over-drying, with one noting less oiliness and clearer skin and another noting it resolves a rough texture after cleansing.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or normal-to-dry skin are split: several report it does not over-dry their skin, while others describe it as very drying, causing dermatitis, scabbing, or skin coming off with the sponge.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally find it not too drying and effective at keeping skin clean, though one warns it can feel drying if overused.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: some describe it as gentle, refreshing and non-irritating even with eczema or rosacea, while others report burning, redness, breakouts, or a severe flare-up of rosacea and eczema, and note the fragrance is a problem for sensitive noses.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 40s with hormonal acne and worsening hyperpigmentation reports the bar improved her skin, while a 48-year-old reviewer with rosacea and eczema reports a severe negative reaction.

concerns.aging: One reviewer mentions age-related brown spots on the face and neck improving with use; skin tags are reported by one user as appearing smaller, though this is a single, atypical observation.
concerns.dehydration: Opinions split sharply: many say the bar cleanses without drying or stripping, but multiple reviewers report significant dryness, tightness, dermatitis, or skin damage, especially with frequent use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness, including one describing a red, painful pimple calming within hours; however, one reviewer with rosacea/eczema reports a severe flare-up, and one with fair, redness-prone skin sees no change in overall redness.
concerns.barrier: A small number of reviewers describe barrier damage, including burning, skin lifting off in bits, and scab-like healing; most other reviews do not mention barrier issues.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers who mention dark spots, hyperpigmentation, or discoloration report visible fading or brightening, often within one to a few weeks; a couple of reviewers report no noticeable change in discoloration.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report clearer skin, faded acne marks, and fewer breakouts over time; a few report the opposite, including inflamed breakouts, burning during use, and one case of the product breaking out the face specifically (though not the underarms) for the same user.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers with oily or combination skin report the product controls oiliness and leaves skin feeling clean rather than greasy, with one noting skin gets greasier and breaks out if she skips regular use.

aspects.libelle: Jar/sponge hygiene concerns, including reported mold
Can feel harsh or stripping if overused

extraits.texte: I have normal to dry skin and when i used this product it made my face even more dry. The sponges are completey unsanitary and once i used it, it not to mention burned my skin AND took the skin off with it. The skin was taken off it little bits and it healed in a scab/wound way. Also, this product has fragrance so if you are sensitive to smell, i would steer clear if this product.

extraits.titre: Wouldn't recommend for People with Rosacea
extraits.texte: Let me start by saying that my skin is very sensitive, 48 years old, impacted with rosacea and additional intermittent eczema. That being said this product line is purported to be safe for sensitive reactive aged skin. Also let me say that the reaction I experienced with this product line was not retinol purging. I had been using IS Clinical Products for several years including their anti-aging retinol products. Unfortunately I used these products only twice and I dealt with a severe flare up of rosacea & eczema. So now this cream sits in my plastic tub that collects products I have purchased yet can't use. I can't comment on long-term effectiveness or if the products work as claimed by marketing jargon. One other thing. WHAT is with the horrible scent of this product line? If I hadn't had a hypersensitivity reaction to these products and even if they worked as marketed I wouldn't have repurchased any of these products because they smell horrible.

This cleansing bar transformed my skin! I tried it based on the description and ingredients. I have oily skin, I'm in my early 40s and started experiencing hormonal acne and my hyperpigmentation was getting worse from going through a stressful time in my life, and this 3-in-1 clearing bar brought my skin back to life and renewed my confidence! I've been using it everyday for 6 months now with no drying or irritation.

I got a .5 oz free sample of this cleanser and am about to purchase the full size because I like it so much. I've used it every night and noticed my face looks glowy and the brown sun spot in the middle of my forehead that I've been fighting for a few years is much, much less noticeable, almost gone. I have very sensitive skin so I use a very gentle CeraVe wash in the morning, but this has been my night time go-to. This hasn't irritated my eczema or rosacea at all. Also, the .5 oz lasted so long.

As someone that has dry and sensitive skin, you have to work your way up with this product. Start off by using 3 times a week and if your skin can tolerate it, up the days. This product is not going to work over night and you have to be consistent. I only wash my face at night. The retinol, the serum and the orange bottle serum are also staples in my skin care routine. Pair these with black girl sunscreen? Chefs kiss

This cleasing bar is so good. I really leaves my face feeling squeaky clean, and I love the little sponge it comes with, because it exfoliates too. This is definitely a strong cleanse, so maybe once a week I use something gentler, but if I go a few days without using this, I notice immediately that my face feels greasier and sometimes I break out around my chin. I often let the foam generated by scrubbing with the sponge sit on my face for a moment, especially if I have a spot on my chin. As for evening tone, I honestly haven't noticed a change in this, but I have really fair skin that is always showing redness, and I don't think a simple bar of soap can ultimately affect that. I tried this cleansing bar a few years ago in an Ulta sale, and I've been using it religiously ever since; it is one of the few products I never switch out, always use to the end, and make sure to always have on hand.

(Gifted by Urban Skin Rx) This gives me such a good cleanse. I have acne prone skin, large pores, acne marks and combination skin. This cleanser feels great and leaves my skin super clean. The sponge is very nice and provides some gentle exfoliation. I tried using the cleanser as a mask too and I think my face looks a bit brighter and more clear since I've started using it. Definitely recommend for people with similar concerns as me!
